warning.titlePre: Jaguar S-Type V6 Timing Chain Tensioner Failure
paragraphs: If your S-Type has the AJ-V6 petrol engine - that's the X200 generation - timing chain tensioner failure is a documented pattern on this engine. We replace the timing chain, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V6 rebuild.
The S-Type range also included a 2.7d diesel variant, which uses a different engine family (AJD-V6, PSA-sourced) and is not affected by this specific petrol V6 timing chain tensioner issue.
warning.source: Source: LR Engine Specialists, per VRF-jaguar-s-type.md. 2.7d diesel explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to petrol V6 engine only.
